svg.title: Job Scout System — architecture v3, 2026-10-14
svg.desc: Updated from the July 2026 architecture: nightly collection, staged analysis, matching, Jev document selection, factual review, repair, outputs and human application.
svg.text: scrape → analyze → match → generate → review → export — LLM-assisted pipeline, run nightly and by hand, surfaced in Obsidian, Streamlit & Telegram
L1 NIGHTLY AUTOMATION — job_scout_nightly.sh · Hermes archivist · no_agent: true · 0 agent spawns
02:00 LinkedIn / Adzuna / Indeed → staging only · 04:30 Reed / remote APIs / Guardian → one analysis pass, scoring, review & digest
Also: Remotive / Arbeitnow APIs · UK + European searches · Edinburgh local-work searches
lives OUTSIDE the repo · never overwritten by generators
SKILL_SYNONYMS maps job wording → your skills

g.text: scrape-only stages raw jobs; late phase merges and processes the saved pool once

svg.text: manual branch: bypasses analyzer/filter; separate run.py subprocess

g.text: · level classification is title-only + word-boundary keywords; unknown → LLM reads the description
· DB dedupe: URL + matching descriptions; document selection dedupes by output path, keeping the fullest usable posting
· 5 axes: skills 45 · context 40 · location 10 · experience 5 · salary 0 — multiplied by title_relevance

svg.text: REVIEW — reviewer.py · ranked auto-review + manual document review / annotation dialogue
full CV / letter + job posting + source facts → findings; unchanged documents cached by reviewed_sha
review_top_percent: 40 · review_score_threshold: 85 — a badge is advisory; human checks facts and submits

g.text: incremental job DB · URL-dedup against every known posting
context_source: llm | tfidf · analysis / matches / model provenance retained
never shrinks — filtered jobs stay in the DB
per-job folders · strategy / scores / source links in YAML
reviewer.py findings · linked from report frontmatter
A4 export on demand from the PDF tab
application-pipeline board data, read by Obsidian
Dataview queries over YAML frontmatter — filter by
categories · report ⇄ CV ⇄ cover letter wikilinks
00_kanban/ — application tracking + shared local CV references
🌙 nightly_scout.py digest — new matches since last run
delivered via Archivist profile's own bot (Hermes gateway)
unattended overnight run · quiet night → nothing sent
LLM LAYER — llm_client.py · per-stage routing, prompt-size guards and key quarantine
local Ollama remains the last resort
REVIEW ROUTE — GLM-5.3 / reasoning: low · key1 → key2 → … → key7 · same model throughout
one attempt per key; failures advance
· selection.py: top 30% generate / top 40% review + 0.50 floor; unscoreable, expired and locked jobs stay out
· Edinburgh admin / manual / kitchen jobs use verified shared CVs; professional generation and auto-review slots are preserved
· contract / sponsorship / remote scope / runway_fit / action_tier are metadata; sponsorship uses verbatim evidence, never inference
CV project IDs + prepared letter paragraphs
source text selected; no new prose generated
CURRENT SETTING: JIS_DOCUMENT_MODE=jev · if unset, code defaults to legacy (LLM ranking / bridge + source assembly)
Every selected document still needs review. Shared local-work CVs bypass tailored generation; applied / hand-edited documents remain locked.
normal exit + zero jobs on two consecutive nights → select one site
worker fix → live scrape verification → tests → branch for human review
up to 3 rounds / attempt; per-site attempt budget; never auto-merge
timeout / partial / error is recorded separately from a clean dry scrape
jis_hermes_bridge.py: score ≥0.70 → generate directly → jis board
review-editor checks facts against sources; no writer profile
JIS_JEV_MODE defaults to off; shadow / on are explicit settings
Jev pre-audit probabilities do not guarantee factual accuracy
human has final responsibility for document approval and application
